text:
Which statement about the Periodic Table is correct?
A
All the metals in the Periodic Table are transition elements.
B
The halogens are elements in Group I of the Periodic Table.
C
The elements become more metallic across a period from Group I to Group VII.
D
The Periodic Table can be used to predict the properties of the elements.

options.label: A
options.text: All the metals in the Periodic Table are transition elements.

options.label: B
options.text: The halogens are elements in Group I of the Periodic Table.

options.label: C
options.text: The elements become more metallic across a period from Group I to Group VII.

options.label: D
options.text: The Periodic Table can be used to predict the properties of the elements.
